drivingQuestion: Is the clause about redeemed items superfluous?
outcomeNote: clause needed to teach that the fifth is not essential

segments.he: וּבְמַעֲשֵׂר שֵׁנִי וְהֶקְדֵּשׁ שֶׁנִּפְדּוּ. פְּשִׁיטָא! לָא צְרִיכָא, שֶׁנָּתַן אֶת הַקֶּרֶן וְלֹא נָתַן אֶת הַחוֹמֶשׁ. וְקָא מַשְׁמַע לַן דְּאֵין הַחוֹמֶשׁ מְעַכֵּב.
segments.en: The mishna also stated that one may establish an eiruv «with» the «second tithe and consecrated» food «that have been redeemed.» The Gemara asks: «It is obvious» that these foods may be used to establish an eiruv. The Gemara answers: This ruling «was only needed» for a case «where one» redeemed the second tithe or consecrated food and «paid the principle but did not pay the» additional «fifth» of their value, which must be paid when they are redeemed. «And» the mishna «teaches us» that the failure to pay «the» additional «fifth does not invalidate» the redemption. Once the principle is paid, even if payment of the additional fifth is still outstanding, the article is regarded as redeemed and may be used for mundane purposes.
